query: SELECT c.id card_id,c.form,c.translation_de gloss,c.pos,c.form_label_de,se.sense_key,se.gloss_de sense_gloss,se.definition_de,s.id sentence_id,s.text,s.translation_de,cs.gap_start,cs.gap_end,cs.valid_alternatives FROM card_sentences cs JOIN cards c ON c.id=cs.card_id JOIN senses se ON se.id=c.sense_id JOIN sentences s ON s.id=cs.sentence_id WHERE cs.removed_in IS NULL AND c.removed_in IS NULL AND s.removed_in IS NULL ORDER BY c.id
